q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an aluminium foil container?
title: Foil container carbon footprint per piece
short: Multiply the foil per container, including skeleton scrap, by your foil supplier's per-kg aluminium figure. Add press electricity, lubricant, lids and packing, then divide by containers passed. Aluminium is almost all of the total, so the foil figure matters most.

ul: Aluminium foil by weight per container; ask the foil roller whether it is primary or recycled metal.
Skeleton scrap sold back, which is not counted in the container.
Mechanical or pneumatic presses with dies.

p: Report per container with its weight. Foil from recycled metal has a much lower figure than primary foil.

example.title: Worked example: foil container unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 5,680 / 1,000,000 = 0.00568 kg CO2 per container
Add aluminium foil for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
